title: Correctness of virtual head movements
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$. The vector of virtual head directions selected from the state of $c$ and the head-centered payloads at offset $0$ equals the shift vector of the totalized action of $M$ at $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x$
replaced:
For every binary machine $M$ and every configuration $c$ of $M$ on an input $x$, the
vector of virtual head directions selected by the controller from the control state of
$c$ and the head-centered payloads at offset $0$ equals the shift vector of the
totalized action of $M$ at $c$; in particular native input clamping and source work
head movement are reproduced exactly.
